title: A majority is not a margin of safety.

analysis.claim_ceiling: Exact deterministic metadata-accounting sensitivity under the declared membership, fixed selection/weight and equal-field-cost assumptions. Reassignment budgets are hypothetical, not measured error rates. Completion bounds are marginal metadata-membership intervals, not a joint multiclass completion or physical truth. No actual audit, new pixels, physical capture merge, NASA pipeline finding, scientific discovery or acceptance.
analysis.oracle_independence: Partial: common metadata/assumptions; separate native recount and small exhaustive oracle required.

assumptions.blank_membership: unconstrained binary membership for one target value
assumptions.recorded_membership: fixed at r=0; at most r binary target memberships may be reassigned in each separate sensitivity extremum
assumptions.selection: original nonblank query frozen; a reassigned recorded field stays nonblank
assumptions.weights: positive fixed integer archive-accounting weights, not scientific value or exposure time
assumptions.resolution_cost: one unit per individual field; real viewing, adjudication, retrieval and support costs unknown
assumptions.grouping: original frozen filename/order-conditioned capture keys; physical identity unvalidated

acceptance: Consumer parity only; uncoached comprehension, accessibility conformance and scientific acceptance unverified.
